changelog:
Initial release of the comprehensive document learning system with multi-document support.

- Supports reading and learning from large PDF and text documents with automatic encoding detection.
- Tracks progress (chapter/page) for each document, allowing you to pause, resume, and switch between multiple documents seamlessly.
- Extracts and saves key concepts and learning summaries into a searchable long-term memory (MEMORY.md).
- Provides commands for checking progress, resuming from the last position, and reviewing all active learning documents.
- Handles large files via chunked processing to ensure stable performance.
summary: Comprehensive document learning system with progress tracking, resume capability, and long-term memory integration. Use when you need to read PDF/text docume...
